studies.title: Milford Sound
studies.caption: Steep forested walls and Mitre Peak rise directly above the water of Milford Sound.
studies.prompt: Water-level view toward Milford Sound's Mitre Peak sharp triangular summit rising from dark forested fjord slopes, smooth grey-green water, fine pale waterfall on one rain-wet cliff. Distinct steep Fiordland landscape, no cruise boat or resort.
